properties.name: vanillabp.workflow-modules
properties.description: What single workflow modules tell the Business Cockpit, by workflow module id. Below '<module>.cockpit': 'workflow-module-uri', 'ui-uri-type', 'ui-uri-path', 'i18n-languages', 'bpmn-description-language', 'template-path', 'group-hierarchy', 'initiator-source'. Below '<module>.workflows.<process>.cockpit', for one workflow: 'bpmn-description-language', 'i18n-languages', 'template-path', 'initiator-source'. Below '<module>.workflows.<process>.user-tasks.<task>.cockpit', for one user task: 'template-path'. The most specific level wins. VanillaBP 1 also read 'group-hierarchy-bean-name' below '<module>.cockpit'. This version does not: which groups may see a workflow module is answered by the WorkflowModuleDetailsProvider bean.

properties.name: vanillabp.cockpit.user-tasks-enabled
properties.description: Whether user tasks are reported at all.

properties.name: vanillabp.cockpit.workflow-list-enabled
properties.description: Whether workflows are reported at all.

properties.name: vanillabp.cockpit.initiator-source
properties.description: Who answers the initiator of a report: 'by-application' or 'system'. It has no default, so a workflow module which reports to the cockpit and says it nowhere ends the start. A workflow module and a single workflow may answer it for themselves, and the most specific value wins: 'vanillabp.workflow-modules.<module>.cockpit.initiator-source' and 'vanillabp.workflow-modules.<module>.workflows.<process>.cockpit.initiator-source'.

properties.name: vanillabp.cockpit.rest.connect-timeout
properties.description: How long establishing the connection to the cockpit server may take. A span of time: a number of milliseconds ('1500'), ISO-8601 ('PT10S') or a number with a unit ('10s', '1500ms', '2m', '1h').

properties.name: vanillabp.cockpit.rest.read-timeout
properties.description: How long the cockpit server may take to answer. A span of time: a number of milliseconds ('1500'), ISO-8601 ('PT10S') or a number with a unit ('10s', '1500ms', '2m', '1h').

properties.name: vanillabp.cockpit.rest.verify-ssl
properties.description: Whether the certificate the cockpit server presents is checked at all.

properties.name: vanillabp.cockpit.rest.authentication.basic
properties.description: Whether a basic authentication is sent, with 'username' and 'password'.

properties.name: vanillabp.cockpit.rest.authentication.oauth.basic
properties.description: Whether the client identifies itself in an Authorization header rather than in the form the token request carries.

properties.name: vanillabp.cockpit.rest.authentication.oauth.connect-timeout
properties.description: How long establishing the connection to the authorization server may take. A span of time: a number of milliseconds ('1500'), ISO-8601 ('PT10S') or a number with a unit ('10s', '1500ms', '2m', '1h').

properties.name: vanillabp.cockpit.rest.authentication.oauth.read-timeout
properties.description: How long the authorization server may take to answer. A span of time: a number of milliseconds ('1500'), ISO-8601 ('PT10S') or a number with a unit ('10s', '1500ms', '2m', '1h').

properties.name: vanillabp.cockpit.rest.authentication.oauth.verify-ssl
properties.description: Whether the certificate the authorization server presents is checked at all.

properties.name: vanillabp.cockpit.process-engine-api.remembered-user-tasks
properties.description: How many delivered user tasks one node keeps in memory. Only the Business Cockpit adapter for the Process-Engine-API reads it: that BPMS cannot be asked about a task a second time, so the node keeps what arrived with the delivery until the task is gone. The memory is one per node and shared by every workflow module, so the key is read here only, and a workflow module which writes it at 'vanillabp.workflow-modules.<module>.cockpit.process-engine-api.remembered-user-tasks' ends the start.
